title: PPL/UL (DGP)
author: Gurdeep Singh
desc: This 5-day program combines Push, Pull, and Legs with Upper/Lower splits, focusing on building muscle and strength. Each 90-minute session includes essential compound and isolation exercises, ensuring balanced development. Ideal for beginners and intermediates, you'll enhance your lifting technique and boost overall fitness. Get ready to see noticeable gains in strength and muscle definition.
